name: codex-model-switch
title: Codex Model Switch
description: Configure and switch the Codex quick model switch router from Raycast.
author: thomas

commands.name: start-llm-server
commands.title: Toggle LLM Server
commands.description: Configure, start, or stop the Codex model switch router.

commands.name: switch-codex-model
commands.title: Switch Codex Model
commands.description: Switch the active Codex model from configured router shortcuts.

commands.name: codex-model-switch-status
commands.title: Codex Model Switch Status
commands.description: Show router, LaunchAgent, and active model status.

preferences.name: upstreamBaseUrl
preferences.title: Upstream Base URL
preferences.description: OpenAI-compatible upstream endpoint that the local router forwards requests to.

preferences.name: upstreamApiKey
preferences.title: Upstream API Key
preferences.description: Required bearer token for the upstream endpoint.

preferences.name: binaryPath
preferences.title: Router Binary
preferences.description: Path to the built codex-quick-model-switch binary.

preferences.name: listenAddr
preferences.title: Router Listen Address
preferences.description: Local address used by the router LaunchAgent.
